section.title: CVAR Changes
section.para: This section outlines CVARs which have changed from older jaymod versions to &project:title;. If you are already running &project:version; then you should skip this section.

listitem.para: g_censor accepts either { 0, 1 } to respectively { disable, enable } the censor feature. The words list is read from a censor.db located in the &project:name; directory, with one word per line.
g_xpSave accepts { 0, 1 } to respectively { disable, enable } the XP-save feature. XP data is stored in the SQLite database (xmod.db).
g_userConfig specifies the SQLite database filename. Default is xmod.db. All user data, admin levels, bans, and XP saves are stored in this database.
